papers.title: High-throughput light-sheet 3D microscopy of whole rodent brain microstructure for integration with MRI
papers.translated_title: 全脑啮齿动物脑微结构的高通量光片三维显微成像及其与MRI的整合
papers.author: Hanmer, J. M.
papers.summary: Whole-brain cellular mapping is essential for understanding how cellular architecture shapes brain organisation and function. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) provides whole-brain coverage but is only indirectly sensitive to cellular features, motivating integration with microscopy to improve the interpretation and specificity of microstructural MRI. Here, we present a scalable cross-resolution framework integrating 3D light-sheet microscopy (LSM) of intact rodent brains with diffusion MRI (dMRI) to bridge cellular and macroscopic brain imaging. By combining active tissue clearing and immunolabelling with accelerated LSM acquisition, we achieve multiplexed mapping of neuronal and glial populations across the whole brain on timescales comparable to conventional histology. We apply this framework across eight genetically diverse mouse strains to develop predictive models of microscopy-derived cellular features from multi-shell dMRI contrasts. Data-driven combinations of dMRI contrasts predicted neuronal and astrocytic features better than individual contrasts across animals. This framework enables scalable integration of MRI and 3D LSM, providing a means to identify cellular determinants of MRI contrast and guide the development and interpretation of microstructural MRI measures ultimately translatable to the living human brain.
papers.translated_summary: 全脑细胞图谱对于理解细胞构筑如何塑造脑组织与功能至关重要。磁共振成像（MRI）能够提供全脑覆盖，但仅对细胞特征具有间接敏感性，这促使将其与显微成像整合，以提高微结构MRI的解释性和特异性。在此，我们提出一个可扩展的跨分辨率框架，将完整啮齿动物脑的三维光片显微镜（LSM）与扩散MRI（dMRI）相结合，以桥接细胞与宏观脑成像。通过将主动组织透明化和免疫标记与加速LSM采集相结合，我们实现了在可与传统组织学相当的时间尺度上对整个脑内神经元和胶质细胞群体的多重图谱绘制。我们在八种遗传多样性小鼠品系中应用该框架，以从多壳dMRI对比中建立显微成像衍生细胞特征的预测模型。数据驱动的dMRI对比组合在跨动物预测神经元和星形胶质细胞特征方面优于单一对比。该框架实现了MRI与三维LSM的可扩展整合，为识别MRI对比的细胞决定因素提供了手段，并指导微结构MRI测量的开发与解释，最终可转化至活体人脑。

papers.title: Interconnected reservoirs of multidrug-resistant bacteria and plasmids within hospital plumbing infrastructure
papers.translated_title: 医院管道基础设施中多重耐药细菌与质粒的互联储库
papers.author: Annavajhala, M. K.
papers.summary: Hospital sinks and wastewater streams are hotspots for contamination and colonization with multidrug-resistant Gram-negative bacteria (MDR-GNB). While hospital water systems may facilitate MDR-GNB transmission during outbreaks, longitudinal population dynamics of environmental MDR-GNB and their long-term relationship with patient isolates remain unclear. Here we aimed to characterize the diversity and abundance of MDR-GNB within the hospital built environment and evaluate their relationship with clinical isolates. We performed nanopore sequencing on MDR-GNB cultured from sink drains (n=523) and wastewater (n=146) at a New York City hospital between March-August 2023. We assessed spatial and longitudinal genomic strain and plasmid dynamics and quantified relatedness to historical clinical isolates from the same hospital (n=602). Sink drains (54-73%) and wastewater (100%) demonstrated widespread, longitudinal colonization with MDR-GNB, driven primarily by carbapenem-resistant GNB including opportunistic organisms and Enterobacterales encoding blaKPC. While bacterial colonization differed across environmental niches, we identified both MDR-GNB strains and resistance plasmids that were shared between clinical and environmental sources, as well a distinct interplay between clinical and wastewater versus sink drain samples. This study supports the role of hospital plumbing as an important reservoir for clinically relevant MDR-GNB, but highlights differences across environmental sources, which may impact surveillance approaches.
papers.translated_summary: 医院水槽和废水系统是多重耐药革兰阴性菌（MDR-GNB）污染和定植的热点。尽管医院水系统可能在疫情暴发期间促进MDR-GNB传播，但环境中MDR-GNB的纵向种群动态及其与患者分离株的长期关系仍不清楚。本研究旨在表征医院建筑环境中MDR-GNB的多样性和丰度，并评估其与临床分离株的关系。我们对2023年3月至8月期间纽约市一家医院的水槽排水口（n=523）和废水（n=146）中培养的MDR-GNB进行了纳米孔测序。我们评估了空间和纵向的基因组菌株及质粒动态，并量化了其与同一医院历史临床分离株（n=602）的相关性。水槽排水口（54-73%）和废水（100%）均表现出MDR-GNB的广泛纵向定植，主要由耐碳青霉烯类革兰阴性菌驱动，包括机会性病原体和携带blaKPC的肠杆菌目。尽管不同环境生态位的细菌定植存在差异，但我们鉴定出临床和环境来源之间共享的MDR-GNB菌株和耐药质粒，以及临床与废水样本和与水槽排水口样本之间不同的相互作用模式。本研究支持医院管道系统作为临床相关MDR-GNB重要储库的作用，但强调了不同环境来源之间的差异，这可能影响监测策略。

papers.title: Molecular Modulation of the SAM-I Riboswitch Drives Global Dynamical Shifts
papers.translated_title: SAM-I核糖开关的分子调控驱动全局动力学转变
papers.author: Nair, V.
papers.summary: A surge in antimicrobial resistance in recent years has made protein-targeting antibiotics less effective against key pathogens. It is possible to expand the range of therapeutic targets by using RNA-based therapies, but it remains necessary to improve the molecular-level understanding of interactions between RNA and known and potential binders. The SAM-I riboswitch, which controls the transcriptional termination of gene expression involved in sulfur metabolism in most bacteria, is an excellent ligand target. Thus, understanding its behavior with and without ligand complexes would be helpful for drug design. Here, we studied the interactions between the SAM-I riboswitch and its natural ligand, SAM, which controls riboswitch function, and compared those to its interactions with the similar small molecule SAH, which does not control riboswitch function, and to its interactions with a potential binder JS4, identified via virtual screening. From our simulations, we deepen understanding of small molecule interactions with the SAM-I riboswitch on both a local and a distal level. The results reveal how differently ligands (SAM, SAH and JS4) can bind to and potentially induce conformational changes in the riboswitch. Our findings offer valuable insight into the molecular mechanisms underlying riboswitch RNA-ligand interactions for the design of more effective RNA-targeting therapeutics.
papers.translated_summary: 近年来抗菌药物耐药性的激增使得靶向蛋白质的抗生素对关键病原体的效力下降。利用RNA疗法有可能扩大治疗靶点的范围，但仍有必要在分子水平上加深对RNA与已知及潜在结合物之间相互作用的理解。SAM-I核糖开关控制大多数细菌中参与硫代谢的基因表达的转录终止，是一个极佳的配体靶点。因此，了解其在有配体复合物和无配体复合物情况下的行为将有助于药物设计。在此，我们研究了SAM-I核糖开关与其天然配体SAM（控制核糖开关功能）之间的相互作用，并将其与类似小分子SAH（不控制核糖开关功能）的相互作用以及通过虚拟筛选鉴定出的潜在结合物JS4的相互作用进行了比较。通过我们的模拟，我们在局部和远端层面加深了对小分子与SAM-I核糖开关相互作用的理解。结果揭示了不同配体（SAM、SAH和JS4）与核糖开关结合并潜在诱导构象变化的方式差异。我们的发现为核糖开关RNA-配体相互作用的分子机制提供了有价值的见解，有助于设计更有效的RNA靶向治疗药物。

papers.title: Hybrid RY-mers increase aDNA alignment sensitivity
papers.author: Tolstoganov, I.
papers.summary: One of the key steps in ancient DNA data analysis is the accurate identification of endogenous short reads that originate from the ancient genome. Currently, this step is performed using general-purpose sequence aligners, such as BWA-aln, with parameter settings optimized for sensitivity. This approach results in increased runtime, even relative to standard DNA alignment workflows, and is not sufficient for aligning samples that are highly divergent from a reference database. We introduce hybrid RY-mers, a seed construct designed to incorporate aDNA-specific sequence damage. We adapt hybrid RY-mers to the existing concept of multi-context seeds and implement them in the read aligner strobealign. On simulated genomic and metagenomic datasets, we show that hybrid RY-mers result in higher mapping accuracy, while also reducing runtime by 4-6 times compared to the state-of-the-art aDNA alignment method BWA-aln. Furthermore, substituting aDNA aligner MALT in the metagenomic tool-suite aMeta with our new alignment approach demonstrated that aMeta gave a faster and less memory consuming detection of ancient taxa present in the samples.
papers.translated_summary: 古DNA数据分析的关键步骤之一是准确识别源自古代基因组的内源性短读段。目前，该步骤使用通用序列比对器（如BWA-aln）完成，其参数设置为优化灵敏度。这种方法导致运行时间增加，甚至相对于标准DNA比对流程也是如此，并且不足以比对与参考数据库高度分化的样本。我们引入混合RY-mers，这是一种旨在纳入aDNA特异性序列损伤的种子构造。我们将混合RY-mers适配到现有多上下文种子的概念中，并在读段比对器strobealign中实现它们。在模拟的基因组和宏基因组数据集上，我们表明混合RY-mers导致更高的比对精度，同时与最先进的aDNA比对方法BWA-aln相比，运行时间减少4-6倍。此外，在宏基因组工具套件aMeta中用我们的新比对方法替换aDNA比对器MALT表明，aMeta对样本中存在的古代分类群给出了更快且内存消耗更少的检测。

papers.title: Implicit Hierarchical Tensor Decomposition of Single-Cell Four-Omics Data Reveals Cell-Type-Linked Candidate Enhancer--Promoter-Associated Programs
papers.translated_title: 单细胞四组学数据的隐式层次张量分解揭示细胞类型相关的候选增强子--启动子关联程序
papers.author: Taguchi, Y.-h.
papers.summary: Single-cell multi-omics provides complementary views of gene regulation, but integrating modalities with natural features comprising enhancers, genes, and three-dimensional (3D) genomic loci remains challenging. This study developed an implicit hierarchical tensor decomposition framework and applied it to the CHARM single-cell four-omics mouse brain data (GSE303006) by jointly analyzing ATAC, H3K27ac, RNA, and reconstructed 3D enhancer--promoter (E--P) distances. After quality control, 730,969 E--P pairs, 42,669 enhancers, 16,239 genes, 391,435 20-kb bin pairs, and 4,258 cells were retained. Each modality was independently reduced to 20 components and mapped to an implicit 730,969x4{,}258x20x4 tensor, which was decomposed without materializing the full array. In a joint model, cell type explained more variance than biological replicate for all 12 distinct cell components represented among the 100 largest Tucker core elements. A representative core linked the Inh_Ndnf/Lamp5--Ex_L3/4_IT cell axis to contrasting presynaptic-transmission and developmental/morphogenetic candidate E--P-associated programs. Its E--P and cell factors were recovered when the whole analysis was repeated independently on each pair of replicates, and the E--P pairs it prioritized agreed in direction with the cell-type-resolved enhancer--gene links of the original CHARM study. No single modality reproduced the program, which required the combination of accessibility, chromatin contact, and expression. Backprojection showed reproducible ATAC, H3K27ac, and 3D effects across three biological replicates; RNA differed clearly for the developmental module but not for the presynaptic module. The framework thus identifies regulatory structure that is shared across molecular modalities and is not recoverable from any single modality.
papers.translated_summary: 单细胞多组学为基因调控提供了互补视角，但整合包含增强子、基因和三维（3D）基因组位点等天然特征的模式仍具挑战性。本研究开发了一种隐式分层张量分解框架，并将其应用于CHARM单细胞四组学小鼠脑数据（GSE303006），联合分析ATAC、H3K27ac、RNA和重建的3D增强子—启动子（E—P）距离。经过质量控制，保留了730,969个E—P对、42,669个增强子、16,239个基因、391,435个20-kb bin对和4,258个细胞。每种模式独立降维至20个成分，并映射到一个隐式730,969×4,258×20×4张量，该张量在未物化完整数组的情况下进行分解。在联合模型中，对于100个最大Tucker核心元素中所代表的全部12个不同细胞成分，细胞类型解释的方差均多于生物学重复。一个代表性核心将Inh_Ndnf/Lamp5—Ex_L3/4_IT细胞轴与对比性的突触前传递和发育/形态发生候选E—P相关程序联系起来。当在每对重复样本上独立重复全部分析时，其E—P因子和细胞因子均可被恢复，且其优先排序的E—P对在方向上与原始CHARM研究中细胞类型分辨的增强子—基因链接一致。没有任何单一模式能够重现该程序，该程序需要可及性、染色质接触和表达的联合。反向投影显示ATAC、H3K27ac和3D效应在三个生物学重复中可重复；RNA在发育模块上差异明显，但在突触前模块上不明显。因此，该框架识别了跨分子模式共享且无法从任何单一模式中恢复的调控结构。

papers.title: Simple models outperform single-cell foundation models on downstream benchmarks
papers.translated_title: 简单模型在下游基准测试中优于单细胞基础模型
papers.author: Souza, H.
papers.summary: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data exhibit strong and reproducible statistical structure. This has motivated the development of large-scale foundation models, such as TranscriptFormer, that use transformer-based architectures to learn a generative model for gene expression by embedding genes into a latent vector space. These embeddings have been used to obtain state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on downstream tasks such as cell-type classification, disease-state prediction, and cross-species learning. Here, we ask whether similar performance can be achieved without utilizing computationally intensive deep learning-based representations. Using simple, interpretable pipelines that rely on careful normalization and linear methods, we obtain SOTA or near SOTA performance across multiple benchmarks commonly used to evaluate single-cell foundation models, including outperforming foundation models on out-of-distribution tasks involving novel cell types and organisms absent from the training data. Our findings highlight the need for rigorous benchmarking and suggest that the biology of cell identity can be captured by simple linear representations of single cell gene expression data.
papers.translated_summary: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据展现出强烈且可重复的统计结构。这推动了大规模基础模型的发展，例如TranscriptFormer，其采用基于Transformer的架构，通过将基因嵌入潜在向量空间来学习基因表达的生成模型。这些嵌入已被用于在细胞类型分类、疾病状态预测和跨物种学习等下游任务上获得最先进（SOTA）的性能。在此，我们探讨是否可以在不利用计算密集型深度学习表征的情况下实现类似的性能。使用依赖仔细归一化和线性方法的简单、可解释流程，我们在多个常用于评估单细胞基础模型的基准测试中获得了SOTA或接近SOTA的性能，包括在涉及训练数据中不存在的新细胞类型和生物体的分布外任务上优于基础模型。我们的发现凸显了严格基准测试的必要性，并表明细胞身份生物学可以通过单细胞基因表达数据的简单线性表征来捕捉。

papers.title: Large seed size accompanying GmSDP1 suppression is linked to cellular remodeling and phytohormone regulation
papers.translated_title: 大种子伴随GmSDP1抑制与细胞重塑和植物激素调控相关
papers.author: Mukherjee, T.
papers.summary: Soybean (Glycine max) seeds contain approximately 20% oil and 40% protein and are important for food, feed, and biofuel. Improving soybean productivity and seed quality requires optimizing carbon partitioning during seed development. Previously, seed-specific suppression of the lipase-encoding gene Sugar-Dependent 1 (SDP1) increased seed oil content by approximately 5% while slightly reducing raffinose family oligosaccharides without compromising protein content. Seed-specific SDP1 suppression also increased seed size by 18-25% without affecting seed number, resulting in greater seed biomass per plant. To determine the developmental basis of the increased seed size, we investigated the cellular and molecular mechanisms underlying this phenotype. Microscopy and biochemical analyses showed that larger seeds were associated with increased seed cell size and enhanced lignocellulosic cell wall accumulation. Temporal biochemical and transcriptomic analyses further revealed coordinated changes in hormone homeostasis, including altered levels of abscisic acid, 12-oxo-phytodienoic acid, and jasmonoyl-isoleucine, together with differential expression of F-box and RING/U-box family genes. The results indicate that the enhanced seed size resulting from SDP1 suppression is associated with coordinated changes in cellular development, cell wall accumulation, hormone homeostasis, and regulation of gene expression during seed development. Developmental and metabolic changes associated with the increased seed size phenotype support SDP1 manipulation as a potential strategy for improving soybean seed yield and quality.
papers.translated_summary: 大豆（Glycine max）种子约含20%的油和40%的蛋白质，对食品、饲料和生物燃料具有重要意义。提高大豆生产力和种子品质需要优化种子发育过程中的碳分配。此前，种子特异性抑制编码脂肪酶的糖依赖性1（SDP1）基因可使种子含油量提高约5%，同时略微降低棉子糖家族寡糖而不影响蛋白质含量。种子特异性抑制SDP1还使种子大小增加18-25%而不影响种子数量，从而导致单株种子生物量增加。为确定种子大小增加的发育基础，我们研究了该表型背后的细胞和分子机制。显微镜和生化分析表明，较大的种子与种子细胞尺寸增加和木质纤维素细胞壁积累增强相关。时间序列生化和转录组分析进一步揭示了激素稳态的协调变化，包括脱落酸、12-氧代植物二烯酸和茉莉酰异亮氨酸水平的改变，以及F-box和RING/U-box家族基因的差异表达。结果表明，SDP1抑制导致的种子大小增加与种子发育过程中细胞发育、细胞壁积累、激素稳态和基因表达调控的协调变化相关。与种子大小增加表型相关的发育和代谢变化支持将SDP1操控作为提高大豆种子产量和品质的潜在策略。

papers.title: A Proteome-Wide Gain-of-Function Atlas Mapping the Landscape of Chemotherapy Response
papers.translated_title: 全蛋白质组功能获得图谱描绘化疗反应全景
papers.author: Jo, K. B.
papers.summary: Background: Conventional chemotherapies remain the core therapeutic backbone of cancer treatment, yet the rapid emergence of chemoresistance often compromises their clinical efficacy. Although large-scale functional genomics has transformed precision oncology, existing reference maps rely predominantly on loss-of-function paradigms and lack systematic data on gain-of-function (GOF) events that commonly drive clinical resistance. Methods: To address this gap, we engineered a site-specific Bxb1 integrase landing-pad system in HeLa cells, enabling single-copy integration of a human proteome-wide library [18,388 open reading frames (ORFs)] at the AAVS1 locus under a uniform EF1 promoter. We systematically profiled cellular fitness across 16 chemotherapeutics. We integrated this GOF perturbation screen with bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing, FACS-based lysosomal functional screening, clinical cohort survival analyses, and preclinical xenograft modeling. Results: Stratified modeling of over 230,000 gene-drug interactions defined distinct functional categories that are strongly enriched for clinical cancer biomarkers and prognostic relevance. Global network analysis and organelle-specific lysosomal functional screening uncovered that chemotherapeutic agents, most prominently the nucleoside analog TAS-102 (Lonsurf), converge upon a shared survival hub centered on the BCL-2 family-associated autophagy-endolysosomal network. Mechanistically, TAS-102 triggered lysosomal activation as an adaptive survival response. Co-treatment with the BCL-2 family inhibitor ABT-263 (Navitoclax) attenuated this TAS-102-induced lysosomal response and synergistically reversed TAS-102 resistance across colorectal and pancreatic cancer models in vitro and in colorectal cell line- and patient-derived xenograft (CDX, PDX) models in vivo. Conclusions: Our study establishes an open-access, proteome-wide GOF reference atlas that systematically maps chemotherapeutic responses, recapitulates canonical resistance biology, and nominates rational drug combinations. This systems-genomics resource bridges massive-scale perturbation mapping with actionable target discovery, providing a translational framework to overcome therapeutic resistance and reprogram cancer drug responses.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：传统化疗仍然是癌症治疗的核心手段，但化疗耐药的快速出现常常削弱其临床疗效。尽管大规模功能基因组学已改变精准肿瘤学，现有参考图谱主要依赖功能缺失范式，缺乏对常驱动临床耐药的功能获得（GOF）事件的系统性数据。方法：为弥补这一空白，我们在HeLa细胞中构建了位点特异性Bxb1整合酶着陆垫系统，使人类全蛋白质组文库[18,388个开放阅读框（ORF）]能够在EF1启动子统一驱动下以单拷贝形式整合至AAVS1位点。我们系统分析了16种化疗药物下的细胞适应性。我们将该GOF扰动筛选与批量及单细胞RNA测序、基于FACS的溶酶体功能筛选、临床队列生存分析以及临床前异种移植建模相结合。结果：对超过230,000个基因-药物相互作用进行分层建模，定义了 distinct 功能类别，这些类别在临床癌症生物标志物和预后相关性方面高度富集。全局网络分析和细胞器特异性溶酶体功能筛选揭示，化疗药物——其中最突出的是核苷类似物TAS-102（Lonsurf）——共同汇聚于以BCL-2家族相关自噬-内溶酶体网络为核心的共享生存枢纽。机制上，TAS-102触发溶酶体激活作为适应性生存反应。与BCL-2家族抑制剂ABT-263（Navitoclax）联合处理可减弱这种TAS-102诱导的溶酶体反应，并在体外结直肠癌和胰腺癌模型以及体内结直肠细胞系来源和患者来源异种移植（CDX、PDX）模型中协同逆转TAS-102耐药。结论：我们的研究建立了一个开放获取的全蛋白质组GOF参考图谱，系统绘制化疗反应图谱，重现经典耐药生物学，并提名合理药物组合。这一系统基因组学资源将大规模扰动图谱与可操作靶点发现相衔接，为克服治疗耐药和重编程癌症药物反应提供了转化框架。

papers.title: Shared experimental materials inflate and reorder cross-participant decoding benchmarks
papers.translated_title: 共享实验材料会膨胀并重排跨参与者解码基准。
papers.author: Cui, H.
papers.summary: Decoding mental states from brain activity underpins brain-computer interfaces and cognitive neuroscience. Decoders are judged by how well they generalize to people left out of training, taken as evidence that they capture what transfers between brains. However, most benchmarks present the same experimental materials to every participant, so held-out participants are tested on materials the model has already seen. Here we show, across 15 EEG, fMRI and eye-tracking datasets and 318 matched comparisons, that shared materials inflate cross-participant accuracy by up to 46 percentage points. They also reorder methods, reversing the advantage of foundation models over handcrafted features on the largest emotion EEG benchmark. The inflation tracks cross-participant item identifiability and, in sealed prospective tests, vanished where items could not be identified. Adding training items improved new-material accuracy more reliably than adding participants. These findings call for reporting new-material accuracy alongside conventional scores and for measuring item identifiability first.
papers.translated_summary: 从大脑活动中解码心理状态是脑机接口和认知神经科学的基础。解码器的评判标准是其在未参与训练的人群上的泛化能力，这被视为解码器捕捉到了大脑之间可迁移内容的证据。然而，大多数基准测试向每位参与者呈现相同的实验材料，因此留出参与者的测试材料是模型已经见过的。本文通过15个EEG、fMRI和眼动追踪数据集以及318组匹配比较表明，共享材料会使跨参与者准确率虚高最多46个百分点。共享材料还会改变方法排序，在最大的情绪EEG基准上逆转了基础模型相对于手工特征的优势。这种虚高与跨参与者项目可识别性相关，并且在密封的前瞻性测试中，当项目无法被识别时，虚高消失了。增加训练项目比增加参与者更能可靠地提高新材料准确率。这些发现要求除常规得分外还应报告新材料准确率，并首先测量项目可识别性。

papers.title: Widespread oscillatory suppression in autism persists in the absence of psychotropic medication.
papers.translated_title: 自闭症中广泛的振荡抑制在缺乏精神药物的情况下持续存在。
papers.author: Amorim, A. K. J.
papers.summary: Purpose: Investigate the neural oscillatory activity associated with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) using electroencephalographic (EEG) recordings in children and adolescents. Compare the corresponding oscillatory power between ASD patients taking psychotropic medication with a drug-naive group. Methods: ASD diagnosis was done using DSM-IV and CARS (Childhood Autism Rating Scale). EEG recordings employed 22 scalp electrodes (10/20 system). ASD vs. neurotypical groups were matched for sex and age (5 females; average age: ~10 years old). We analyzed the resting state (eyes open) EEG power spectrum during ~2-minute recordings. The multitaper FFT method was used to estimate spectral power for the delta, theta, alpha, beta and gamma frequency bands. We pooled together data from several electrodes to compute comprehensive power spectra and assess the oscillatory behavior of macro brain regions. Results: We observed widespread (~4Hz - 20Hz) oscillatory suppression comprising the theta, alpha and beta frequency bands. The most widespread and robust ASD-associated power suppression was in the high theta and alpha bands. Delta and gamma bands showed no significant power change for any of the brain regions studied. Results from a subgroup of patients (N = 9) who never used psychotropics confirmed these findings, indicating that they are not an artifact of medication. Conclusion: Suppression in theta, alpha and beta oscillations may offer insights into the neurophysiological underpinnings of autism and could be used as an accessible and comprehensive tool in ASD diagnosis, regardless of the patients being or not on medication.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：利用儿童和青少年的脑电图记录，研究与自闭症谱系障碍相关的神经振荡活动。比较服用精神药物的自闭症谱系障碍患者与未用药组的相应振荡功率。方法：自闭症谱系障碍诊断采用DSM-IV和CARS（儿童自闭症评定量表）进行。脑电图记录使用22个头皮电极（10/20系统）。自闭症谱系障碍组与神经典型组在性别和年龄上匹配（5名女性；平均年龄约10岁）。我们分析了约2分钟记录期间的静息状态（睁眼）脑电图功率谱。采用多锥度FFT方法估计delta、theta、alpha、beta和gamma频段的频谱功率。我们汇总了多个电极的数据以计算综合功率谱，并评估大脑宏观区域的振荡行为。结果：我们观察到广泛的（约4Hz-20Hz）振荡抑制，涵盖theta、alpha和beta频段。最广泛且最稳健的自闭症谱系障碍相关功率抑制出现在高theta和alpha频段。delta和gamma频段在所研究的任何脑区均未显示显著功率变化。从未使用精神药物的患者亚组（N=9）的结果证实了这些发现，表明它们不是药物造成的伪影。结论：theta、alpha和beta振荡的抑制可能为自闭症谱系障碍的神经生理学基础提供见解，并可作为自闭症谱系障碍诊断中一种可及且全面的工具，无论患者是否正在服药。
